subject: Relist legacy connector as bundled SKU for Marketplace / Co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Penny Alvarez <partners@cloudscale.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.chen@amazon.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Connector relist request — deprecated 'CloudScale Connector' -> bundled SKU

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — Penny from CloudScale here. We’ve been notified that the CloudScale Connector listed last year will be deprecated in the marketplace listing next quarter (it’s tied to a standalone SKU). Per our roadmap, we want to relist the offering as a bundled connector SKU (CloudScale + Redwood runtime) so customers can continue to buy without a migration gap.

High level asks from our side:
- Confirmation of marketplace relisting process for GCP/Azure/AWS and expected timeline.
- Co-sell readiness checklist (what evidence/certificates Redwood needs from us).
- Any changes required to pricing and partner entitlements for sell-with versus listing-only.

We can provide package artifacts and an updated tech brief. Adding Laura from AWS for visibility since this impacts our joint listings.

Attached: short manifest (see link below) — will follow up with full evidence bundle.

Best,
Penny Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, CloudScale Solutions
partners@cloudscale.com

Attachment: manifest-stub.txt (referenced)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Penny Alvarez <partners@cloudscale.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Connector relist request — deprecated 'CloudScale Connector' -> bundled SKU

Hi Penny — thanks for the heads up.

We’re open to relisting as a bundled SKU but need to run this through a short playsheet so the listing and co-sell entitlements line up across cloud marketplaces. Can you confirm the following and attach the items below?

Immediate asks (we need these to scope workstreams):
- Technical artifact: signed compatibility matrix + runtime manifest (binary hashes not required in first pass).
- Security: brief on data flow + SOC/Sec certifications that apply to the connector.
- Commercial: proposed list price and suggested resale/discount tiers.

Process note: If relisting touches a Private Offer / Managed Listing, we’ll need legal to review redlines and procurement to route SKU mapping. We’ll likely run a co-sell enablement sprint once evidence passes initial review (2 weeks target).

Olga — can you own the evidence intake and mark any gating items? Vivek, please flag if we need a partner contract amendment for co-sell entitlements.

Penny — please attach a single evidence zip and the pricing spreadsheet. I’ll loop Jordan for a short demo once we have a working bundle.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

--
On Fri, 17 May 2028 at 09:12 AM Penny Alvarez <partners@cloudscale.com> wrote:
> (original message)
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Penny Alvarez <partners@cloudscale.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Connector relist request — intake checklist + evidence template

Marissa / Penny — attaching our intake checklist and the evidence template. Quick notes:

Evidence intake checklist (summary):
- Architecture diagram (customer data paths) — required
- Minimal reproducible demo + runbook for HA/scale — preferred
- Security attestations (SOC2 type II pdf, encryption-at-rest details) — required
- Third-party dependency list + license declarations — required
- Support contact and SLA commitments for the bundled SKU — required

Commercial asks: 
- We need the proposed MSRP and suggested partner resale margins in the pricing-proposal.xlsx so we can map to Cloud & Redwood SKU entitlements. If CloudScale wants co-sell prioritization, indicate expected joint pipeline and a target launch window.

Legal: we’ll need the draft contract redlines before Private Offer plumbing; attached a redline template (legal-redlines.docx) for CloudScale to fill.

I’ll triage evidence as it arrives and send a gating report within 48 hours.

Olga Petrov
Director, Partner Operations — Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Attachments (stubbed): relist-intake-checklist.pdf, evidence-template.md, legal-redlines.docx
From: Penny Alvarez <partners@cloudscale.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.chen@amazon.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Connector relist request — evidence attached

Hi Olga / Marissa — attaching the evidence bundle and draft pricing. Highlights:
- relist-evidence.zip (contains architecture-diagram.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf, demo-runbook.md)
- pricing-proposal.xlsx (MSRP suggestions; includes a partner-resale tab)
- legal-redlines.docx (we filled primary redlines; see section 4 on indemnities)

A few notes on the commercial ask: CloudScale is asking for a co-sell tag on the listing and a 10% promotional discount window for three months post-launch. We expect a small pipeline (initially 5 pilots) but higher enterprise adoption in Q4.

Laura — curious if AWS requires any additional evidence beyond the SOC summary for Private Offers?

Next steps for us: please confirm receipt and expected timeline for an intake review. If possible, would like a target relisting week in June to avoid the deprecation window.

Thanks,
Penny

Attachments: relist-evidence.zip (3 items), pricing-proposal.xlsx, legal-redlines.docx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 May 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Connector relist request — internal next steps and DocuSign

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Intake looks reasonably complete. Proposed internal plan:

1) Olga to run evidence gating (48 hours). If green, Product (Jordan) to validate the demo/runbook and sign off on the bundled packaging.
2) Legal to confirm the contract redlines; Marissa to shepherd partner commercial terms.
3) Commercial ops to prepare SKU mapping and Private Offer routing across AWS/GCP/Azure (target 10 business days after sign-off).

Jordan — can you schedule a 30-min demo with CloudScale next Tue (22 May) 10–11am PT? We need to validate the HA/scale claims and sample tokens-per-second under our runtime.

Marissa — I drafted a short DocuSign for the co-sell addendum and uploaded it here: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcdef-123456. Please review and send to Penny once you’ve reviewed pricing.

Marissa, Olga — ping me if you need me to escalate to CS for onboarding credits.

— Vivek
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
